The '''Kanto Fair host''' is a [[character of the day]] who appeared in ''[[BW116|The Fires of a Red-Hot Reunion!]]''.

During their trip to the {{an|White Ruins}}, {{Ash}}, {{an|Iris}}, {{an|Cilan}}, and {{an|N}} came across the [[Kanto Fair]] in [[Virbank City]], which was showcasing the treats and Pokémon that originated from the [[Kanto]] [[region]]. The host of the fair was due to show off the Kanto [[first partner Pokémon]] and began with {{p|Charmander}}. However, things went wrong, and Charmander was injured. With the help of Ash and {{ashfr}}, she rushed it to the local [[Pokémon Center]], where it was quickly healed. She later apologized to the gang for any trouble she had caused, but they replied that they were just glad that Charmander was all right.
